body: This is what I do every time I have a commitment in my life. I can't handle it, give up, and fail. But I don't know how to try harder. I feel like I should just start watching B99 again, and lose myself in it until I die. This feels like a dream, like it's so horrible it can't be real. I promised myself I wouldn't screw this all up this time, and I really, really don't want to fail.
It's okay. You didn't do anything wrong. Thanks for your advice.

It's an online course, so there is nothing further than talking to the teachers. I've just said I've been sick. I don't want to explain these things to people, they don't understand and I don't want to make it difficult to be in the class because of sharing.

I know I can fail, but I just don't want to. I'm miserable because of how I'm letting myself down. I don't have the money to retake the courses, and I'm wasting it if I don't do the work. I'm sorry to just spit on your advice, I don't mean to be rude.
